test_mcts_agent_tic_tac_toe: test the MCTS agent by running a tic-tac-toe episode with MCTSBot and MCTSAgent
create_mcts_bot: create an MCTSBot with a game, exploration constant, max iterations, and rollout evaluator
create_mcts_agent: create MCTSAgent instances for each player with player_id, num_actions, and shared mcts_bot
run_mcts_episode: run an MCTS agent episode by stepping through a tic-tac-toe environment until the game ends
test_mcts_agent_episode: test the MCTS agent by resetting the environment, selecting actions via agent.step, and stepping the environment
